import json, subprocess, sys, time
# complete DAG on nodes 0..49 (huge number of partial paths) + direct edge 0->95 (dest)
n=96
edges=[]
for u in range(0,50):
    for v in range(u+1,50):
        edges.append({"u":u,"v":v,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"})
edges.append({"u":0,"v":95,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"z"})
doc={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[2]*n,"edges":edges,
     "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
raw=json.dumps(doc).encode()
print("input bytes", len(raw))
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/work/submission/main.py"],input=raw,capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%(time.time()-t))
o=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("topology_paths",o["summary"]["topology_paths"],"classes",len(o["classes"]),"coverage",o["summary"]["coverage_status"])

# destination unreachable, huge partial path count
doc2={"version":1,"n":n,"capacity":[2]*n,"edges":[e for e in edges if e["v"]!=95],
     "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
raw2=json.dumps(doc2).encode()
t=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/work/submission/main.py"],input=raw2,capture_output=True)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time %.2fs"%(time.time()-t))
o=json.loads(p.stdout)
print("topology_paths",o["summary"]["topology_paths"],"coverage",o["summary"]["coverage_status"])
EOF
